text:
jess chen: Heads up — after merging the alloc prefetch tweak we merged earlier (merge landed ~6503209000) nightly microbench shows p95 up ~15% for 4k sequences. Not huge but consistent across 3 runs. bench artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/bench/6503219876 :eyes:

omar singh: I pulled the artifact and can repro locally. p95 from 230ms -> 265ms with same dataset. Timeline shows a cluster of stalls around step ~120.

ryan k: Any obvious touchpoints to KV cache or the small-batch scheduler? If scheduling changed, that can surface as tail latency.

jess chen: The change was in alloc prefetch + prefill sizing (PR #8425). Minimal diff:
```diff
- prefill_window = 32
+ prefill_window = 48
```
That bumped prefill concurrency for some worker placements.

chandra: I ran a profile on the canary and see more frequent context-switches when the prefill_window is larger — looks like a small-batch scheduling contention. Profile: https://profiles.redwood/6503219876/trace.svg

sam: If that’s the vector, reverting the prefill increase should be low-risk. I’ll open a revert PR unless someone objects. Need a quick review to avoid affecting today's load test.

ci-bot: Canary report: tail p95 increased by ~14% after the merge. All checks green otherwise. https://ci.redwood/reports/canary/6503219876

ryan k: @sam tag me on the revert, I can review within 30m. Also include the exact bench command you used to reproduce so SRE can replay.

sam: Pushing revert PR now: https://git.redwood/pull/6503221000. Repro command I used: `./bench/run --model longseq --seq 4096 --batch 1 --runs 100 --profile timeline`

jess chen: Thanks. Scheduling a rollback window at 16:00 PT if we don't get a canary improvement by then — will hold merging other perf-affecting PRs until resolved. :alarm_clock:

omar singh: +1 to rollback window. I’ll keep running local blamelogs to see if any other changes could be amplifying this.

chandra: Filing follow-up to add a focused microbench around prefill_window permutations and a CI guard: https://issues.redwood/RED-1123

sam: Revert PR ready and tagged @ryan k for review. Will watch the canary after merge and post quick results.

jess chen: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If revert lands and canary stabilizes, we’ll re-open an investigation branch to safely try different prefill values with better profiling hooks. :thumbsup:
